text:
Power Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document lists the equipment inspection, which must be performed on a monthly bases as indicated by M1 in the title
block for Battery Charger:
Model: CLC -130-400 - 5 | AC input:380 
10% V, 158A, 50HZ, 3 PH
S.N:13166 -1,13166 -2,13166 -313166 - 4 | DC
output:130V 400A | No of cells: 58
The first draft initiated by Eng Metwaly 
Mahmoud El_Sayed El_Hendawy and revised by 
Operation and maintenance's General Director: eng Mohamed Reda Abd El-Azez
Safety Precautions
Work order must be issued.
Switch off input & output supply.
Tools and Equipment
Suitable Tool Set, Brush
Digital Voltmeter
Vacuum Cleaner or Blower
Work to be Carried Out
Switch-off input and output supply.
Clean it from air dust and dirty.
Check the ventilation system.
Inspect over heating compartment of control board.
Check fuses, Contacts and Terminal tithing.
Inspect visually the Scrs and Diodes.
Switch on input and output supply.
Check input and output voltage.
